title: Workspace.Unmount request params
description: Per protocol-v0.md §7.3. Tells the daemon this client is done with one workspace root. `root` (a `workspace_id` or a workspace path) selects which mounted root to release; absent, the daemon's default root. Unmounting the last root starts the idle-shutdown timer.

root.description: Mounted root to release: its `workspace_id` (as returned by `Workspace.Mount` / `Workspace.Status`) or its workspace path. Absent = the daemon's default root.
